doc: Play skeletal characters: read the rig and each character's state, send one to a state or set its parameters, layer a clip on part of it, ask where a joint is, sample any clip at any time, step, return to a frame, and ask what would be.

tools.name: skeleton.observe
tools.description: The frame, the state's hash, the rig (joints; clips with their length, raw and compressed bytes and compression error; the machine's states and parameters) and each character: its state, how far its fade is, the last transition and why, its parameters, layers and where it stands

budget.description: the most bytes of answer; characters are left out from the last, and `more` says how many

tools.name: skeleton.play
tools.description: Sends a character to a state of its machine now, fading over some seconds (no condition asked)
tools.undo: skeleton.seek to the frame it was given at

state.description: a state of the machine (skeleton.observe lists them)

tools.name: skeleton.set
tools.description: Sets a parameter of a character's machine (a trigger: 1); its transitions read it from the next step
tools.undo: skeleton.seek to the frame it was given at

tools.name: skeleton.blend
tools.description: Layers a clip over what the machine plays: mixed in by a weight (on a joint's subtree when a mask is given) or added (its difference from its own start); a weight of 0 takes the layer away

mask.description: the joint whose subtree it plays on (every joint when none is given)

additive.description: a boolean (its id): added rather than mixed (false when none is given)

tools.name: skeleton.joint
tools.description: Where a joint is: in the world (the character's place, then the joint in the model's space), its turn and its place relative to the model

tools.name: skeleton.sample
tools.description: Any clip at any time, as a pure function of it: a joint's place in the model (or every joint's, within a budget), the root motion from the clip's start, and the error compression left there

joint.description: every joint when none is given

budget.description: every joint: the most bytes of answer

tools.name: skeleton.step
tools.description: Steps every character (1/60 s a step): machines choose, clips play, root motion carries them
tools.undo: skeleton.seek to the frame it began at

then.why: see where the characters got to

tools.name: skeleton.seek
tools.description: Returns to a frame within the history kept, bit for bit (a checkpoint and the inputs since, given again); what is stepped from there is a new branch
tools.undo: none within the world: what came after the frame is another branch's

then.why: read the characters at the frame returned to

tools.name: skeleton.branch
tools.description: What would be: the characters some steps ahead, one sent to a state first if one is given, observed as skeleton.observe does; the characters themselves untouched

steps.description: how far ahead (1 when none is given)

tasks.name: read-the-rig
tasks.summary: Read the rig and the characters, then sample a clip where a foot lands

tasks.name: make-one-run
tasks.summary: Set a character's speed, step through the fade, and check where its hand is and that it moved forward

tasks.name: wave-while-walking
tasks.summary: Ask what a wave on the upper body would look like before giving it: a branch ahead, then the layer and a step
